Enjoy the music and give your recommendation if you like it. Also, remember to play the full experience in Soulpath: the final journey VR videogame, available on Steam.

notes.title: Soulpath is coming next 25th of June
notes.notes:
We're really proud to announce the launching date of our next game: [b]Friday 25th of June[/b].

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1380660/extras/Intro.gif?t=1611419504[/img]

Soulpath contains 9 unique minigames combined with a simple narrative, a lot of VR fun and challeging achievements.
Every level changes its game mechanics, visual environment, goals and music, featuring an amazing original soundtrack (available for free to download on launch).

Don't forget to add to your [b]wishlist[/b] and support us.
Thanks!

notes.title: Soulpath is finished!
notes.notes:
After some months polishing, adjusting and improving the game, we can happily announce that [b]Soulpath[/b] is finally ready to publish. We need some time for promotion, so the game is coming to Steam in June.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1380660/extras/Intro.gif?t=1611419504[/img]

[b]Lots of news and improvements[/b] have been added since the last demo available during the [i]Steam Festival[/i]. A new taichi level, completelly redesigned fear level, 3 new maze levels, better feedback and player guidance, finished original soundtrack, actress recorded voices, saving slots, end credits, 29 challenging steam achievements and more.

We'll be organizing some [b]broadcasts[/b] with the new features and levels soon. Stay tuned!

Don't forget to [b]add to your wishlist[/b], follow us and recommend to your friends.

Thanks for the support!
The Game Forger

notes.title: Finished Beta
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce that [b]Soulpath: the final journey[/b] is almost finished. 
After the great feedback from the Steam Game Festival, we've made important adjustments and improvements.

The Fear level gameplay has been redesigned and it's now much more fun. Also, the initial level (Wonder) is a liitle bit more challenging. We've made visual improvements in the last levels and TaiChi (wich was not available in the game festival demo) is almost finished now; and working really well ːsteamhappyː

The game soundtrack, original music by Andoni plaza, is also finished and we plan to release the soundtrack for free when the game launches. So, don't hesitate to give a positive vote it if you like what you listen. Andoni is a novel composer, but he's put  lot of energy into the project.

We'll keep you informed. Remember to [b]wishlist [/b]Soulpath to support us on launch.
Thanks!
